item.title: Minneapolis Under ICE: A Letter on Life, Fear & Resistance - Care More Be Better
item.description: In this special solocast episode, Corinna Bellizzi shares the unedited audio of Matt Braunger reading a powerful letter written by his cousin — a Minneapolis resident describing how federal immigration enforcement has transformed ordinary life in his community. This episode invites listeners to bear witness, reflect on how democracy erodes in daily moments, and consider how staying informed, connected, and engaged can help protect ordinary life before it disappears.

item.title: Eliminating Cancel Culture In Climate With Jenny Morgan
item.description: Jenny Morgan discusses what it takes to get rid of the cancel culture and purist mindset in the climate discourse that often paralyzes the entire movement.

item.title: Sex Trafficking Hidden in Plain Sight: Stories, Systems, and How to Take Action with Melody C. Miller - Care More Be Better
item.description: Sex trafficking often hides in plain sight, sustained by silence and misunderstanding. In this re-released episode, Corinna Bellizzi speaks with Emmy Award-winning filmmaker Melody C. Miller about California’s Forgotten Children, centering survivor stories, real-world impact, and the practical ways communities can recognize, report, and help prevent exploitation.

item.title: How Not to Age: Dr. Michael Greger on Longevity, Protein Myths, and Plant-Based Health - Care More Be Better
item.description: In this Care More Be Better re-release from another podcast Corinna once hosted, Nutrition Without Compromise, Corinna sits down with Michael Greger, New York Times bestselling author of How Not to Die and How Not to Age, to explore what the science really says about aging, protein intake, and plant-based longevity. Together they unpack the difference between lifespan and healthspan, challenge common nutrition myths, and examine how evidence-based dietary choices may help us age with strength ra

item.title: The Right to Roam: Wildlife Corridors, Public Lands & Ecological Regeneration With Hillary Rosner
item.description: Hillary Rosner sheds light on how human progress and modernization hinder wild animals from moving freely and migrating from one place to another.

item.title: How to Save Lives with Your Dollars: Radical Empathy & Effective Altruism with JD Bauman
item.description: JD Bauman delves into the philosophy of effective altruism and how every person on earth can expand their positive impact.

item.title: The Real Story Behind Coffee with Chris Kilham, Medicine Hunter
item.description: Chris Kilham sheds light on the stories of trade, culture, and production behind every cup of coffee we enjoy today.

item.title: Fight Forever Chemicals And Food Dyes | Holding Corporations Accountable With Vineet Dubey
item.description: Vineet Dubey explains how legal pressure, environmental litigation, and consumer awareness can bolster our fight against toxic chemicals.

item.title: Solving Plastic Pollution In Our Ocean With Eric Magers
item.description: Eric Magers discusses potential solutions at the local and national levels to minimize and put an end to plastic pollution in our oceans.

item.title: Smarter Fire Defense For A Hotter, Drier World With Sunny Sethi, CEO Of HEN Technologies
item.description: Sunny Sethi presents a highly innovative and smarter fire defense that leverages AI, IoT, and advanced fluid dynamics.
